release_name: Live TV v4.1.0 — OSD Keypad Dialing, Slow-Mo Replay, Team Alerts & Phone Swipe Surfing
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: 🔢 Direct Channel Number Dialing (TV OSD Overlay & Keypad): Dial any channel number with instant glowing on-screen display (CH 0-9) on Mac keyboard or using the tactile 3x4 numeric keypad on the Phone Remote to jump straight to your favorite station

⏱️ Instant Slow-Motion Replay (0.5×): One-tap 10s instant rewind at half speed with dedicated glowing HUD banner on Mac and 0.5× tool button on Phone TV for reviewing thrilling goals, wickets, and race moments before returning seamlessly to Live

🔔 Sports Team Alerts & Match Notification System: Select your favorite cricket, football, or motorsport clubs (Bangladesh, Real Madrid, Ducati, India, etc.) or add custom teams to receive instant celebrations and 1-tap tune alerts whenever they score or take the field

🎧 Full System MediaSession Integration: Native lock-screen, Control Center, headphone touch gestures, and media keys support on macOS and mobile phone player with rich metadata, channel art, and next/previous surfing
📱 Phone TV Touch Swipe Channel Surfing & Audio EQ: Swipe vertically on the mobile player to surf channels effortlessly (Swipe Up for next, Down for prev), with multi-mode Audio EQ voice boosting
